description.value: A museum dedicated to the history and culture of Chinese Canadians, housed in the Hoy Sun Ning Yung Benevolent Association building on Fan Tan Alley — North America's narrowest commercial street. Located in Canada's oldest surviving Chinatown (est. 1858), it features rotating exhibits, artifacts, and community programming. Free admission makes it an easy stop for touring cyclists passing through downtown Victoria.
